stem: A TV's price moved from €600 to €599 between two 4-week periods, and its units from 50 to 53. The arc elasticity comes out at about -35. What is the soundest reading?

options.text: The price barely moved, so random changes in units drive the number
The TV is extremely price sensitive, so a deeper price cut would pay off
The start-point formula would give a far smaller and truer number
An elasticity this large proves that the sales data holds an error
